abilities.effect: The heavy bricks above the cubby collapse, leaving the sickle unscathed but dealing 4d6+10 bludgeoning damage (DC 26 basic Reflex save) to the triggering creature.
abilities.name: Collapse
abilities.trigger: A creature touches the sickle in the cubby

hazard.description: A hidden string connected to precariously stacked bricks causes the cubby to collapse in on itself when the string is pulled.
hazard.disable: Thievery DC 20 to cut the string without setting off the trap
hazard.name: Rigged Cubby

traits.name: Mechanical
traits.text: A hazard with this trait is a constructed physical object.

traits.name: Trap
traits.text: A hazard constructed to hinder interlopers.
